scenes.title: One Hero Is Not One Plot
scenes.summary: Countless things happen to one man, so a poem about one man is not one plot: the poets of Heracleids and Theseids went wrong.

scenes.title: Homer's Odyssey
scenes.summary: Homer did not put into the Odyssey everything that happened to Odysseus, the wound on Parnassus or the feigned madness, but built it, like the Iliad, around one action.

scenes.title: The Organic Whole
scenes.summary: As in the other arts one imitation is of one thing, so the parts of a plot must be joined so that to move or remove one disturbs the whole.
